entities.summary: Saint-Pierre de Montrouge is a Roman Catholic parish church located at 82 avenue du General Leclerc in the Petit-Montrouge quarter of the 14th arrondissement of Paris It occupies a triangular lot at the intersection of two major streets, the Avenue du Maine and the Avenue General-Leclerc. It was built in 1863 in the Neo-classical style. It was inscribed as an historic monument of Paris in 1982.
